name: Censor with reverse
lesson:
## Reverse the word, keep the beat

Beat Jump pad 8 on the FLX4 reverses playback while held. Press it on beat 4 of bar 1 and release on the one of bar 2; again on beat 4 of bar 3. The word under the reversed beat is gone, and because the software keeps the grid moving, the track resumes in time when you let go.

This is the clean-edit censor: a reversed syllable rather than a gap. The press must sit on the beat where the word starts, and the release on the next beat, so the reverse sounds like a scratch. Practise with the track's lyric sheet; on the night you have one chance.
